data.title: Sick pay (Krankengeld) partly rejected
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 27 January 2026 that your sick pay (Krankengeld) is suspended because your certificate of incapacity for work was reported late. They will only pay from 22 January 2026 instead of 12 January 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your incapacity for work was not reported within one week, so your entitlement to sick pay is suspended (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V). It received the certificate on 22 January 2026 and pays only from that date. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree, for example if you can show the certificate was sent in time. It must be in writing or recorded at the insurer, and the app shows the deadline. Consider getting advice from a counselling service or your insurer if unsure.

items.title: Object to the sick pay decision
items.action: If you disagree, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK or have it recorded there.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final and sick pay for 12 to 21 January 2026 is no longer open to challenge.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
